menu: Open TheKeyMachine preferences, docking, maintenance, updates, and help.
toggle: Show or hide the main TheKeyMachine toolbar.
shelf: Add a button to the current Maya shelf that toggles TheKeyMachine.
reload: Prompt to save the scene, then cleanly stop the current runtime, reload TheKeyMachine modules, and rebuild the toolbar.
unload: Close TheKeyMachine and remove its callbacks, script jobs, temporary UI, and runtime state.
uninstall: Remove TheKeyMachine's Maya startup integration and installed files.
updates: Check for a newer TheKeyMachine release and open the updater when one is available.
preferences: Open toolbar behavior, appearance, startup, and interaction preferences.
startup: Load TheKeyMachine automatically when Maya starts.
tooltips: Show rich tooltips, including interaction details and animated examples.
dock: Move the toolbar between Maya dock areas and choose its top or bottom placement.
system: Open reload, unload, and uninstall maintenance actions.
languages: Choose the toolbar's language and whether tool names are translated too.
help: Open documentation, support, community, and project information.
hotkeys: Open the hotkey editor for assigning TheKeyMachine commands.
workspaces: Open the Workspaces editor to customize toolbar docking, alignment, section order, and pinned tools.
history: Review release notes and changes for installed TheKeyMachine versions.
about: Show the installed version, credits, license, and project information.
donate: Open the project support page in your browser.
bug_report: Send a private bug report or suggestion with useful diagnostic details.
bug_report_menu: Send bug reports and suggestions, and track the status of the ones you've already sent.
